scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.node.json

scripts.test:transcription-worker: uv run --project workers/transcription --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/transcription/tests -v
